claim_text: Concentrated turmeric/curcumin supplements should not be treated as equivalent to culinary turmeric during pregnancy; safety evidence is insufficient to support routine medicinal-dose supplementation.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent avoidable harm from inappropriate supplementation.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation and label.
evidence_summary: NCCIH turmeric resources discuss safety limitations and pregnancy caution.
limitations: Exact source passages and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
